name: manual_5800cf
claim: When a board packet names a source SHA, never reuse a worktree that other live agents share — they can commit under you mid-review (HEAD moved and the working tree changed between two read commands in one session); create a fresh worktree from the exact source_ref SHA even if a checked-out worktree already exists

decisions.notes: During the Agate review another agent committed two slices and the bindings work appeared/disappeared between tool calls; the fresh-worktree rule from the board-job source-line protocol would have avoided the moving-ground hazard.

rationale: During the Agate review another agent committed two slices and the bindings work appeared/disappeared between tool calls; the fresh-worktree rule from the board-job source-line protocol would have avoided the moving-ground hazard.
